question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Pliable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Malleable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pliable"** means something that is easily bent, flexible, or easily influenced. (लचीला)

 
 
• **Example: **The pliable material made it easy to mold into different shapes.
 
 
 
• **"Malleable" **refers to a material or substance that can be easily shaped or bent without breaking. It also can mean easily influenced or adaptable. (ढलने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **Gold is a malleable metal that can be shaped into various forms.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Pliable' **is **'Malleable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Malleable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Probable **(संभावित): Likely to be the case or to happen.

 
 
• **Example:** It is probable that we will finish the project by next week.
 
 
 
• **Severe **(गंभीर): Very great; intense, or harsh.
 
 
• **Example: **The storm caused severe damage to the coastal areas.
 
 
 
• **Rigid** (कठोर): Unable to bend or be forced out of shape; not flexible.
 
 
• **Example:** The rigid structure of the building made it resistant to earthquakes.
 
 

40:Tbf9,

The correct answer is: Option 2
